# internal/contract checks every line is in the pinned server's contract.
# Add a line with each route, field, status or header the client starts
# to rely on.

# The link flow (`loomux login`). The client never makes this call: the
# web's /link page does, for the terminal, with the token hash and the
# label of the link the terminal showed. The terminal's wait is GET
# /api/v1/sessions above, 401 until this call has made the session.
POST /api/v1/sessions
POST /api/v1/sessions request - object
POST /api/v1/sessions request .client_kind string omitempty
POST /api/v1/sessions request .label string omitempty
POST /api/v1/sessions request .token_hash string
